auxiliares:
lemma hasPosDensity_mod_one (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    {n : ℕ | n % m = 1}.HasPosDensity := by
  exact FormalConjecturesUtil.HasPosDensity.arithmeticProgression 1 m hm

lemma trivial_all_have_small_prime_factor (k : ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n % (Nat.factorial (k + 1)) = 1) :
    AllHaveSmallPrimeFactor (k + 1) k n := by
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
  have hi1 : 1 ≤ i + 1 := by omega
  have h_le : i + 1 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
  have h_dvd : i + 1 ∣ Nat.factorial (k + 1) := Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega) h_le
  have h_mod : n % (i + 1) = 1 := by
    have h_div : (i + 1) ∣ Nat.factorial (k + 1) := h_dvd
    have h_rem := Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd n h_div
    omega
  have h_pos : 1 < i + 1 := by omega
  have ⟨p, hp_prime, hp_dvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd h_pos
  use p
  refine ⟨hp_prime, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hp_le : p ≤ i + 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hp_dvd
    omega
  · have h_sum : i + 1 ∣ n + i := by
      have : n + i = n + 1 + (i - 1) := by omega
      -- Instead, just use the fact that n % (i + 1) = 1 means n + i % (i + 1) = 0
      omega
    exact dvd_trans hp_dvd h_sum
